prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1208; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision you were involved in in Pasadena, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name and the address where you currently live.

A: I'd rather just give the address, if that's okay. It's on the policy paperwork already.

Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened leading up to the impact?

A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road heading east. Traffic had been moving steadily, and I came to a full stop behind the car in front of me. I had my foot on the brake and I was waiting for the light to change.

Q: What happened next?

A: The next thing I knew, I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped back and then forward, and my seatbelt locked up across my chest. The other driver had been following too closely, I think. He didn't seem to be braking in time.

Q: Did you get out of the vehicle at the scene?

A: I got out, but my lower back was already stiff and sore. I didn't want to move too much, so I stayed near the car until the police arrived.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They diagnosed me with a lower back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and some anti-inflammatory medication. I've been doing some physical therapy twice a week since then.

Q: Are you currently experiencing any limitations because of the injury?

A: Yes. Sitting for long periods is hard, and lifting anything heavy makes it worse. I've had to take some time off work, and I'm still getting used to that.

Q: Thank you for your answers. Is there anything you would like to add that I haven't asked about?

A: No, I think that covers it. I appreciate your patience.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
